title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
caption:
🌍 BREAKING: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha

Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.
